name: MTB press-fit bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer average 71 g for the exact SM-BB71-41A HOLLOWTECH II press-fit bottom-bracket assembly. The table lists 89.5 mm and 92 mm shell-width options without selecting one weighed width. This is the A model; no weight is transferred from the longer C version.
